idea: Why to-do lists make you less productive
text:
What if writing every task makes you slower? [pause] I see this all the time [look at camera] and it’s not a myth [emphasize] here's the thing [confident] to-do lists can backfire on your productivity [pause] because they create mental clutter [smile]

First [pause] you start thinking about every step [look down then back up] which slows your brain [pause] then you check off items [quick gesture] and that triggers guilt [pause] even if you didn’t finish [pause] finally you overcomplicate simple tasks [pause] making each step harder [pause]

Try skipping the list and just pick one thing [pause] then do it [look at camera]
title: Why To-Do Lists Hurt Your Focus
